description: A two-layer synth for pads, strings, ear candy and soundscapes, played from a sunset horizon instead of a wall of knobs: drag the sun for motion and tone, shape the rest with six macros. 50 presets inspired by Tame Impala, Massive Attack, Brent Faiyaz, Mike Dean and Travis Scott.
highlights: Seven sources per layer: Juno-style analog, string machine, formant choir, FM glass, electric piano tines, pitched air, sine
Tape wow and saturation, lo-fi, Juno / Solina ensemble, phaser, dub delay, shimmer reverb, tempo pump and gate
Drag the sun to set Motion and Tone; Swell, Tail, Blend, Grit, Echo and Space reshape any preset
50 presets: TAME IMPALA, MASSIVE ATTACK, BRENT FAIYAZ, MIKE DEAN, TRAVIS SCOTT
installTips: Every macro's centre position is the preset as designed: double-click a knob, or the sun, to go back to it.
Pump, gate, delay and synced LFOs follow FL Studio's tempo.
previewNote: on the same four-chord progression (Dm9, Bbmaj7, Fmaj7, Am7) at 120 BPM; mono leads play the top line.
